oneOf.description:
Roles in its namespace. Never requestable or break-glass, and any
standing access they give waits for a person.

Mappings of IdP groups to roles its namespace owns. Never to a
built-in role.

approvers.description: Who may approve its held changes, besides admins.

bot.description: The `bot` document whose logins may write. One grant per bot.

kinds.description:
What it may write. Never `bot`, `discovery`, `resource_profile`, or
`policy_writer`: those are for people (ADR-0042 §4).

names.description: Patterns every document name must match: exact, or `prefix*`.

namespace.description: The one namespace the writer owns documents in. Not `default`.

profiles.description: The profiles its resources may complete.
